title: Counterpoint's decade-deep pure-Flowable practice sits outside the EU beachhead
content:
Counterpoint Consulting has delivered Flowable across North America for more than ten years, and the record calls it the deepest pure-Flowable practice found. Pure matters here: it is not a large integrator with Flowable among many alliances but a firm whose practice is the platform, which is the strongest possible version of the carrier profile.

The disqualifier is entirely geographic — it is outside the EU beachhead — and that is a strategy constraint rather than a judgement about the firm. The thesis being sold leans on European sovereignty and procurement arguments that do not transfer to a US buyer, and a first design partner has to be reachable within the market where those arguments are already funded.

Which is why the row is deferred to priority 3 rather than excluded. Depth of practice is the scarcest attribute in this cohort, so if the beachhead ever widens, or if a US expansion is considered, this is the reference case for what a committed Flowable partner looks like. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder, mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
